description: This file implements the Resolver class for managing configurations, resolutions, and plugin calls within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It handles loading JSON configurations, resolving aliases, parsing alias strings, and invoking Thunder plugins.

classes.name: Resolver
classes.description: Implements configuration loading, alias resolution, and plugin invocation within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

methods.name: LoadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from a JSON file, parsing resolutions and storing them internally.

methods.name: IsConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the resolver has any loaded resolutions.

methods.name: ResolveAlias
methods.description: Returns the alias associated with a given key.

methods.name: ParseAlias
methods.description: Parses an alias string into callsign and method components.

methods.name: CallThunderPlugin
methods.description: Invokes a Thunder plugin method based on the alias and parameters.

methods.name: HasEvent
methods.description: Checks if a resolution has an associated event.

methods.name: HasIncludeContext
methods.description: Checks if a resolution includes context and retrieves it.

methods.name: HasComRpcRequestSupport
methods.description: Checks if a resolution supports ComRpc requests.

methods.name: HasPermissionGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the permission group associated with a resolution.
